metadata.title: Phases in the cyclic quantum dilogarithm: correction to "Cyclic quantum Teichmüller theory"
metadata.abstract: We first correct $\boldsymbol{\mu}_N$-phase issues in the basic definition around the cyclic quantum dilogarithm operators in [Ish26]. In particular, the notion of global coefficients must be extended by incorporating additional lifting data forming a $\boldsymbol{\mu}_N$-cover, and the pentagon relation generally acquires an extra $\boldsymbol{\mu}_N$-factor. Nevertheless, we prove that every point in a regular locus of the partially compactified cluster Poisson variety lifts to a \emph{strict} extended global coefficient, for which this extra $\boldsymbol{\mu}_N$-factor is trivial. Consequently, the original statements of [Ish26] hold for such lifts and are therefore restored.

analysis.progressType: 量子 Teichmüller 理论修正
analysis.workSummary: 修正循环量子双对数中的 μN 相位：全局系数需加入提升数据形成覆盖，五边形关系通常多出相位；在正则 locus 的 strict 提升上额外因子为一，恢复原定理。
analysis.breakthrough: 明确原理论成立的正确提升数据与正则范围。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方摘要和作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读完整证明。原陈述恢复是通过适当提升实现，不能忽略额外相位而沿用未修正定义。 AI 披露另见独立全文核查。
